{{Top|leg}}
'''Spacers' Town''' was a small section of the [[TaggeCo. starport]] on [[Pallaxides]]. It boasted only a single [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] and [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], and catered to [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crews waiting for their cargos to be unloaded.<ref name="GTG">{{WEGCite|story=Gone To Ground|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
